author: alexandertuna
body:
#### PR description:

Here's a small PR to LST ntuple: add an option to keep all sim tracks. Normally, only sim tracks from the in-time hard-scatter collision are saved. This discards information from the other sim tracks, which may be useful when studying data-hungry approaches to tracking, such as machine learning.

#### PR validation:

I have produced a handful of LSTNtuples with this commit and it works as expected.

cc @slava77 @jchismar
title: LSTNtuple: add an option to keep all sim tracks
